subject: Mathematics
title: Class 10 Mathematics Olympiad — Paper 5
instructions: The time allowed for this paper is 60 minutes.
This paper contains 50 objective-type (multiple-choice) questions carrying a total of 60 marks.
There is no negative marking for wrong answers.
Each question has four options; choose the one correct answer.
Section 1 and other regular sections carry 1 mark per question; the Achievers Section carries 3 marks per question.
Use of calculators is not permitted unless specified.

questions.question: Which number should replace the question mark: 3, 9, 27, 81, ?
If '+' means '÷', '÷' means '-', '-' means 'x', and 'x' means '+', evaluate: 12 x 4 - 2 ÷ 3
In a row of children, Raj is 7th from the left and 12th from the right. How many children are in the row?
Find the missing number: 7, 14, 28, 56, __
A is taller than B but shorter than C. D is taller than C. Who is the tallest?
Arrange in a logical order: Seed, Flower, Fruit, Plant, Seedling
Pointing to a photograph, a man says, 'She is the daughter of my grandfather's only son.' How is the girl related to the man?
A is the father of B. C is the sister of A. How is C related to B?
Statement: All pens are pencils. All pencils are erasers. Conclusion: All pens are erasers.
Find the odd one out: Triangle, Square, Circle, Sphere
If 5 workers can build a wall in 12 days, how many days will 10 workers take?
A clock shows 3:15. What is the angle between the hour and minute hands?
Find the next term in the series: 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, __
If in a certain code, MATH is written as NBUI, how is CODE written?
If North becomes East, East becomes South, and so on, what will South become?
A bag contains 3 red and 2 blue balls. What is the probability of drawing a red ball?
In a right triangle, if one acute angle is 30 degrees, what is the other acute angle?
If the zeroes of the polynomial x^2 - 5x + 6 are alpha and beta, find alpha + beta.
Solve for x: 2x + 3y = 12 and x - y = 1. Find the value of x.
What is the mode of the data set: 2, 3, 3, 4, 5, 3, 6?
What is the median of the data set: 3, 5, 7, 9, 11?
Find the roots of x^2 - 7x + 12 = 0.
What is the total surface area of a cube with side 5 cm?
If the sum of first n terms of an AP is 3n^2 + 5n, find the first term.
What is the LCM of 12 and 18?
What is the volume of a cylinder with radius 7 cm and height 10 cm (use pi=22/7)?
What is the value of sin 30 degrees + cos 60 degrees?
From an external point, how many tangents can be drawn to a circle?
If a pair of linear equations has no solution, what is true about the lines they represent?
options: The lines intersect at one point

questions.question: A tangent to a circle touches it at how many points?
If the length of a tangent from an external point 13 cm from the centre to a circle of radius 5 cm is found, what is its length?
Three points A(1,2), B(3,4), and C(5,6) are given. Are they collinear?
options: Yes, they are collinear (lie on the same line)
Only A and B are collinear

questions.question: What is the relationship between the radius and a tangent at the point of contact?
options: The tangent is parallel to the radius
The tangent is perpendicular to the radius at the point of contact

questions.question: Find the area of the triangle with vertices (0,0), (4,0), and (0,3) using the coordinate geometry formula.
A bag contains 4 red, 5 blue, and 6 green balls. What is the probability of NOT drawing a red ball?
A shopkeeper marks up an item by 25% then gives a 10% discount. If cost price is Rs. 400, find the selling price.
A tank can be filled by pipe A in 6 hours and by pipe B in 12 hours. How long will both pipes together take to fill the tank?
A train 150 m long crosses a pole in 15 seconds. Find the speed of the train in m/s.
A shopkeeper's profit percentage is 20% on cost price of Rs. 250. Find the selling price.
A car travels 240 km in 4 hours. What is its average speed?
If 5 pens cost Rs. 60, what is the cost of 12 pens?
A room is 5m long and 4m wide. What is the cost of carpeting it at Rs. 50 per sq metre?
A sum of Rs. 5000 is invested at 8% simple interest per annum. Find the interest after 2 years.
A recipe requires 2 cups of flour for 8 servings. How many cups are needed for 20 servings?
Ravi buys a shirt marked at Rs. 800 with a 15% discount. What is the discounted price?
From the top of a 60 m tall tower, the angle of depression to a car on the ground is 30 degrees. Find the distance of the car from the base of the tower.

A ladder 10 m long rests against a vertical wall such that its foot is 6 m from the wall's base. If the top of the ladder slides down by 2 m, by how much will the foot slide out? (Use Pythagoras theorem)
options: The foot moves out by 6 m
The foot moves out by approximately 3.31 m (new base = 9.31 m, so shift ≈ 3.31 m)
The foot moves out by exactly 2 m

questions.question: A card is drawn from a well-shuffled deck of 52 cards. Given that the card drawn is a face card, what is the probability that it is a king? (Conditional probability)
A quadratic equation representing the age problem: 'The product of Ramu's age 5 years ago and his age 9 years later is 15' leads to which correctly formed equation if x is his present age?
A cone and a hemisphere have equal base radius and equal volumes. Find the ratio of the height of the cone to the radius.
